protocol.analysis: Descriptive paired case outcomes, no inferential population claims; repeated designs are not independent architectures
protocol.budget: Identical ceilings, candidate sets and single-look samples for all selection baselines; no-repair stops after observation/control
protocol.error: alpha .01 divided by (C+3)*M+1; one look per group per subject
protocol.exclusions: None; failed runs retained. No exact-state comparator is claimed information-matched.
protocol.name: counterfactual-recovery-v1
protocol.negative_controls: Clean, readout, gate noise, incomplete Bell distribution, insufficient budget, ambiguous repeated X
protocol.ranking: Interval dominance / conservative upper loss; resources break operational ties only
protocol.verification: Fresh original and selected candidate: candidate upper loss <=1, original lower loss > candidate upper
